title: Codex becomes public
description: The public history begins. This dates the repository, not the invention of the agent loop.

title: A Linux sandbox boundary
description: A dedicated Linux sandbox crate enters the available history.

title: A TypeScript SDK
description: The SDK scaffold adds a programmatic route into the harness.

title: An agent controller
description: An auditable milestone in the collaboration and subagent line.

title: Plan mode in the TUI
description: Plan items and their rendering become visible in the public history.

title: Skill loading
description: Reusable instructions enter the inspected skill-loading history.

title: Lifecycle hooks
description: A hook implementation milestone creates explicit interception points.

title: Historical human approval
description: The earlier AX harness recorded structured approval decisions. This behavior was removed by the v0.3 rewrite.

title: Plugin loading
description: Initial plugin loading precedes marketplace and installation work.

title: Available history starts
description: The imported history already includes AGENTS.md. Import dates do not establish when every feature was first built.

title: A subagent capability seam
description: Delegation is exposed as a composable capability.

title: Codex and Claude hook compatibility
description: A shared hook protocol is direct evidence of interoperability, not proof of copied internal architecture.

title: MCP client
description: Standardized external tool connectivity joins the plugin tree.

title: Skill catalogs
description: Skills become an explicit discoverable capability.

title: Codex as a subagent provider
description: DeepSeek can invoke Codex through a dedicated provider.

title: AX changes architectural layer
description: The v0.3 rewrite replaces the built-in harness with declarative task orchestration. Earlier conversation, approval, and skill-loading features must be read historically.

title: A two-commit source opening
description: The imported code contains many features, but its public history cannot date their original introduction.

title: ZCode source opens
description: The second public commit is the pinned snapshot studied here.
